title: Show a CSV file or a messy table as aligned columns
summary: Turn comma-separated text into neatly lined-up columns so it is easy to read in the terminal. The file itself is not changed; only the screen view is aligned.

aliases.text: format csv as table in terminal
вывести csv в виде таблицы в терминале
сделать таблицу из текста в терминале

steps.explain: column -s, says the input is separated by commas. -t builds a table in which every column is as wide as its longest value. The file stays unchanged.
steps.expect: The same rows with every column padded so that the values line up.

steps.explain: Preview only the first 5 rows of a big file. head cuts the file and the pipe passes those rows to column.
steps.expect: The first rows of the file, aligned in columns.
